title: Independently review #4417's nonlinear centre-sharing floor: Theorems 1-2 hold; all six screen ceilings reproduced by separate code; rank-72 regroup is extremal (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

This adds `research/pr4417-centre-review/`. It is an independent review of Matarener's #4417, the nonlinear and adaptive centre-sharing floor, and its +0.67% packing screen.

**Claim type:** a written proof review plus a separately implemented recomputation of the screen. **No new κ.**

## Results

- **Theorem 1 holds under the inherited premises.**
  - On `V ⊂ ker H` the decoder forces `E` to be injective on a real `16d`-dimensional set.
  - Adaptivity on earlier fresh reads still yields one function `E : V → ℝⁿ`.
  - Invariance of domain covers the continuous case, and semialgebraic dimension preservation covers finite branching.
- **Theorem 2 holds.** It is a bit count, and Kronecker sharpness is re-checked on six small grids.
- **Screen.** I reimplemented the relaxation separately: coverage mass `(m−1)w + centre`, idle mass at rank `R = 51` under `m² > 2R²`, certified intervals, and no import of `ceiling.py`. All six rows match #4417 to `10⁻¹¹`: ratios 1, 1.002113, 1.004233, 1.006359 and **1.006721**, plus the halved-information control at **1.901107**.
- **Rank 72 is the extremal regroup.** The per-unit-mass cost `r^{−a}m^{a−1}` is nonincreasing in `r`, so +0.67% bounds every packing of the 64 centre units into children of rank at most 72.

## Not covered

- #3918's carrier premise.
- Terminal-only consumers.
